why: configuration_loader.py includes every URDF joint with nq > 0 as controlled_joint_names
both finger joints are independent prismatic joints with nq=1; the bundled URDF explicitly removed the mimic element
PinkIKController receives project robot_joint_space=JOINT_NAMES, which is the full 9-joint order
PostureTask uses a full nv-dimensional identity Jacobian, so it actively regularizes both fingers
map_pinocchio_velocity_to_joint_state returns targets and velocities for every controlled_joint_name
frame_task_reason: panda_hand is upstream of the two finger joints in the URDF, so its kinematic Jacobian has no finger motion contribution
dtype_path: Isaac positions are read as float32; _extract_joint_positions converts each to Python float and np.array(...) creates float64 before mapping into the Pinocchio q vector
design_intent: PINK arm IK plus an independently commanded gripper
actual_architecture: PINK configuration/QP/output include arm plus fingers; project then overwrites PINK finger targets with an independent gripper command
